name: Hermes Agent
author: grandpaacademy
description: Self-hosted AI agent by Nous Research. OpenAI-compatible gateway API (port 8642), web dashboard (port 9119), persistent memory, skills, and multi-profile support.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Hermes Agent Install Script
apt update
apt install -y curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "[hermes] Install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: OpenRouter API key for LLM access. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys

variables.name: Anthropic API Key
variables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude models. Get one at https://console.anthropic.com/

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: OpenAI API key for GPT models. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

variables.name: Enable Dashboard
variables.description: Enable web dashboard (1=enabled, 0=disabled). Dashboard runs on port 9119.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Dashboard login password. Generated per-instance by the panel at creation; change it here any time.

variables.name: Enable API Server
variables.description: Enable OpenAI-compatible API server on port 8642

variables.name: API Server Key
variables.description: API server authentication key (auto-generated if blank). Clients must send as Bearer token.
